name: 16503 · Erie, PA
findings: ZIP 16503 (Erie) has 45 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 16503 (Erie) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 16503 (Erie) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 62% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 11% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
